name: Opper
short: EU-hosted (Stockholm) LLM gateway and router exposing 700+ models from 50+ providers via one OpenAI-compatible API, with zero data retention by default, LLM checks, routing/fallbacks, and observability.

plans.name: Gateway (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Bring your own keys with no markup on inference; 3% platform fee on credit purchases; metadata-only logging (zero data retention) by default; high rate limits; management API; community support via Discord.

plans.name: Control Plane (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Everything in Gateway plus full traces retained 1-30 days, org/project budgets and spend caps, model allowlists and per-role/user/key access, routing rules, SSO/SAML, audit logs; premium email support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom terms or keep data in your own cloud; dedicated Slack + SLA; custom hosting regions; tailored DPA; ZDR routes needing signed agreement (Azure OpenAI, Gemini Vertex); invoicing.
